مُتَبَّرٌ Broken up [and] destroyed: so in [the saying in the Kur vii. 135,] هٰؤُلَآءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَا هُمْ فِيهِ [As to these people, that wherein they are shall be broken up and destroyed]. (S.) ―
-b2- رَأْىٌ مُتَبَّرٌ Counsel destroyed, or brought to nought. (TA, from a trad.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
